【原视频简介】
Claude Code AI Agent on USB lets you carry a portable AI coding setup across Windows, Mac, and Linux. Run Claude Code from a USB drive, external SSD, or any folder and keep your coding environment portable.

In this video, I’ll show you how to set up Claude Code Portable on a USB drive and use the same setup across Windows, macOS, and Linux — including the terminal and browser-based dashboard.


You’ll see the complete setup process on Windows first, then move the same USB drive to Mac and Linux and continue working with the same configuration, projects, settings, and saved provider setup.


✔ Run Claude Code from a USB drive
✔ Claude Code on Windows, Linux & Mac✔ Browser-based Claude Code dashboard
✔ Connect multiple AI providers
✔ Use USB, external SSD, or internal SSD
